name: jiffy-toolkit
description: Creative and standards tools: /teach-me for interactive scrollytelling explanations, /frontend-slides for HTML presentations, /explain for self-contained HTML explainers of research documents and pull requests, /sound-like-me for removing AI writing patterns and writing in a named voice, /reflect for extracting session learnings to persistent storage, /optimize-for-opus5 and /optimize-for-fable5 for model-specific prompt optimization, plus editorial, diagram, and skills-authoring standards with companion review agents.
